title: Amplified Daydream
description: A modpack designed to enhance the amplified world experience wich can be played in singleplayer or multiplayer. It is very fun to play with friends. It isnt recomended to play in a normal world.
body: This modpack is designed to make amplified worlds even more exciting. You can play it alone or with friends in multiplayer, and it’s a lot of fun to explore together. The mods are made to work best with the unique, hilly terrain of amplified worlds, so it’s not recommended for regular world types. Enjoy a more thrilling Minecraft experience with this modpack!
